name: Editorial Focus Timer
prompt: Build a warm editorial focus timer: cream paper background, dark espresso typography, terracotta primary button, oversized tabular countdown, thin ink dividers, generous gutters. No cards, no motivational slogans, no privacy boilerplate. Start, pause/resume, reset, and 5/15/25-minute presets must work; pausing preserves time and restarting after the countdown finishes starts a full new interval. Give it a distinctive printed-journal feel. Use Contract state only. Include tests for pause/resume, reset, and restarting after completion.
